Its only licence metadata is Elsevier's article-level TDM user licence (https://www.elsevier.com/tdm/userlicense/1.0/, Crossref query fetched 2026-09-18, JSON sha256 ba74c872805c2eb7b7e5506f122061d1134a3dfe35c1baf2e25ae67de5cdf408) -- a notice about the article, not a term on the instrument. Same originator and same verdict as the shipped siblings yuebo_2024_sysquality and _srvquality (batch_241, also Urbach et al. 2010).
